reason: Binary-rounded outer-box boundaries can make a mathematically boundary-touching corner cell have a computed minimum squared norm of 16.000000000000007 at radius 4. A strict bare floating comparison would incorrectly classify such boundary-uncertain cells as wholly outside the ball

observed_before_correction.interpretation: The corner cells are boundary-uncertain, not evidence of a substantive outside-ball region; they must be retained

correction.rule: Discard a cell only when minimum_norm_squared > r^2 + 1e-12*(1+r^2); otherwise retain it for denominator classification
correction.scope: This tolerance is used only for the outside-ball classification and makes the cover more conservative by retaining more cells. It never creates a finite interval for an unresolved denominator and never relaxes the negative-denominator gate
correction.structural_expectation: The original outside_cell_count=0 remains unchanged; the new numerical tolerance prevents spurious boundary exclusion
correction.implementation: Record the tolerance in every grid and in analysis_scope, and include this amendment's hash in the result
